fusions.name: Loaded Fingers
fusions.desc: Points a finger and fires a shot that deals 7 fire damage to the first enemy it meets. Your first shot at an unwounded enemy has 50% more critical chance. It holds 5 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Scattershot Palm
fusions.desc: Thrusts out an open palm that goes off with a crack, dealing 28 fire damage that ignores armour to everything in a cone 4 tiles long.

fusions.name: Steadied Wrist
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Itchy Trigger
fusions.desc: When you go too long without a critical hit, your next ability deals 30% more damage. Once every 10 seconds.
